text:
maya: Heads-up : heavy drizzle + puddles by 3rd & Townsend. Caltrain signal issue reported, might slow the afternoon commute. Stay flexible! ☔️

noah: Ugh timing. I have a client call at 5:15. Anyone know if the 5:00 to SF is still running?

transit-bot: CALTRAIN ALERT: Operations slowed due to signal malfunction near Bayshore. Expect 15-30 minute delays on northbound and southbound services. Monitoring. https://caltrain.org/status

jess: Thanks bot. Pro tip: if you're coming from the Mission, the T-Third has extra cars but it's packed. Bring snacks. 😂

omar: My scooter is free if someone wants a (speedy but slightly soggy) ride to 4th & King. Helmet mandatory. DM me.

sarah: Also FYI the office garage entrance has a new puddle that turns shoes into soup. Put down a towel by the lobby if you want to dry them out.

maya: Poll: who needs a ride? React 🚲 for bike, 🛴 for scooter, 🚗 for carpool, 🚶 for walking. I'll try to coordinate.

noah: Reacted 🚗 (late but willing to share)

jess: 🛴 (tempted)

omar: 🛴 (freebie coming up)

sarah: 🚶 (brisk walk cures all)

maya: Update: 2 🛴, 1 🚗, 1 🚶. Omar, sending you a DM with ETA.

transit-bot: Reminder: If you expect to miss a meeting by >10 minutes, please update the meeting thread or ping the host. Saves confusion.

noah: Quick logistics q - is the 6pm team dinner still on if folks are delayed?

jess: I'm gonna hold off ordering until 5:20. If delays hold, we can postpone 30m. Not a crisis.

sarah: Also someone put a silly inflatable duck in the breakroom sink. Whoever did that, bravo. Quacks for morale. 🦆

omar: That was me. Duck is now street-anchored outside to warn puddle-approaching pedestrians. You're welcome.

maya: Alright team, coordinating rides now. Stay safe, and if the rain amps up, consider working from home tomorrow if your commute looks rough.

transit-bot: Note: Signal crew expects progress updates every 20 minutes. Check https://caltrain.org/status for live ETA.

noah: Thanks y'all. Heading out early to avoid the worst. Coffee for the duck when I return? ☕️
